title: First Run: Guided Capacity Tour & Autoscale Pattern Illustrations
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Design a first-run guided capacity tour for Dedicated that combines an explainer sequence (microcopy + illustrations) with an interactive capacity slider, autoscaling pattern visualizations (steady, reactive, scheduled), and an SLA overview card. Target audience: platform engineers and product teams during initial Dedicated setup. Goal is to reduce setup time and SLA confusion while increasing correct autoscale configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Figma files contain screens for wizard step, capacity slider states, autoscale pattern animations, and SLA card
Assets include export-ready SVGs and PNGs for release notes and help center
Copy reviewed and approved by PM and localization team
Design tokens used from Redwood design system and components referenced
Hand-off notes include interaction specs, animation timing, and accessibility notes
review_feedback: PM Alyssa: prefer single-line SLA summary with tooltip for details
Eng Samir: ensure autoscale preview uses real telemetry ranges; requested sample latency curves
Design Lead Priya: reduce color palette for patterns to meet WCAG 2.1 AA
decisions: Use three autoscale pattern presets (steady, reactive, scheduled) with preview charts rather than free-form examples
Include SLA badge with two-line summary + link to full SLA doc
Prototype uses interactive slider that updates estimated throughput and cost in real time
next_steps: Address Samir's telemetry integration question with engineering during sync on 2025-03-07
Produce final SVG exports and hand-off tokens by 2025-03-10
Add localized copy placeholders and open i18n ticket
